overview: Pull the enchantments off an item and into a book, at a lectern. Server-side only: a vanilla lectern and a vanilla book hand back a vanilla enchanted book, so players need nothing installed.

1.0.1: Reading an item on an empty lectern now says what each enchantment actually does in plain English, not just how near the ceiling its level is.
1.0.0: The step vanilla is missing between the grindstone and the anvil. Put a blank book and quill on a lectern, right-click it with an enchanted item, and the item comes back clean while a book carrying its enchantments pops off.
The price is a book and quill, no levels. Curses stay put, the prior-work penalty is cleared, and everything moves at once.
